description: This file defines several custom attributes related to concurrency and request handling in Orleans grains, such as ReadOnly, Reentrant, Unordered, StatelessWorker, AlwaysInterleave, MayInterleave, and OneWay, along with their associated behaviors and properties.

classes.name: ReadOnlyAttribute
classes.description: Marks methods as read-only to enable runtime optimizations for non-modifying grain methods.

classes.name: ReentrantAttribute
classes.description: Marks a grain class as reentrant, allowing request interleaving for performance improvements.

classes.name: UnorderedAttribute
classes.description: Marks grain interfaces where message delivery order is not significant.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerAttribute
classes.description: Indicates a grain class is stateless and can have multiple activations, with optional configuration for local workers and idle worker removal.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Marks methods that can interleave with any other request, including write requests.

classes.name: MayInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Marks classes that control request interleaving via a callback method specified at construction.

classes.name: OneWayAttribute
classes.description: Marks methods as one-way, with no response sent back to the caller.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Provides properties for grain classes to specify behaviors and attributes related to concurrency.
